units.source_text: 古歌：“一枝紫草生原野，遍地闲花尽有情。”

en.t: An old poem says: "When a single sprig of purple gromwell grows in the open field, all the scattered flowers around it take on feeling."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 紫草比大女公子，闲花比浮舟也。

en.t: The purple gromwell represents the elder princess, while the other flowers represent Ukifune.
